verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a first-party Zapier integration: its webhooks trigger Zapier to fetch transcripts when meetings are processed, which can route notes onward to other apps. Nothing in the evidence shows native Slack or Notion integrations, so two of the three named destinations are unproven. Missing for 10: native Slack channel posting, native Notion page sync, detail on what note content Zapier receives, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Connect Fireflies webhooks to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.
A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows
